name: g68_sb_kings_shield
purpose: Steel Beam into King's Shield (cross-row G66 x G68, decision 0015 items 5cb and 5cc): Gholdengo (no contact) aims Steel Beam at Aegislash (M) behind King's Shield. The shield stops it (-activate move: Protect) with no Attack drop, because Steel Beam makes no contact. Steel Beam's onMoveFail recoil (round(maxhp/2) to the user, [from] steelbeam) follows the Protect, as the pin does for Protect (g68_sb_protect).
